title: How Large Real Estate Corporations Handle Increases
description: Official SEC EDGAR figures; portfolio-level evidence only, not SF-specific or a legal benchmark.

rows.label: Independence Realty Trust Q4 2025
rows.value: Same-store new leases -3.7%; renewal 2.9%; blended 0.8%; occupancy 95.4%; retention 61.4%

rows.label: IRT 2025 value-add
rows.value: 2,003 renovations; average $251/month increase over unrenovated comparables

rows.label: All large corporations generalization
rows.notes: No official source proves what all large corporations do.

rows.label: Essex Property Trust - San Francisco County, Q4 2025
rows.value: Average monthly rental rate $2,966 vs $2,897 in Q4 2024 (+2.4%); 1,356 apartment homes; financial occupancy 95.5%; gross revenues +2.0%
rows.notes: Official Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1, page S-9, re-verified 2026-11-11. County-level same-property data; the filing does not say how individual rents were set or whether any unit is rent-controlled.

rows.label: Essex Property Trust - blended rate growth, FY2025
rows.value: Blended same-property net effective rate growth +2.5% for FY2025, portfolio-wide
rows.notes: Taken from footnote 7 of the same filing, which defines the measure; portfolio-wide and not San Francisco-specific. Quarterly tradeout columns are not published here because their column labels were not captured unambiguously.

rows.label: Equity Residential - FY2025 Form 10-K
rows.notes: Filing confirmed retrievable 2026-11-11; no San Francisco-specific figure extracted, so none is published. See F15.
